julia_auditor: Hi all — auditor follow-up: for the prod inference key we need evidence for key lifecycle + RBAC changes and a few sample decrypt events tied to a deploy. Minimum ask: key version timeline, signed key policy, RBAC change entries for infra/service accounts, 3 sample decrypt audit lines with request_id -> deploy tag mapping, and any emergency unwraps in the past 12 months. ETA?

raj: hi julia — can do. suggest we scope to prod-svc-inference as the deploy tag. I'll coordinate exports. Quick Q: do you need raw audit payloads or a sanitized CSV? auditors prefer raw with PII redacted.

julia_auditor: sanitized CSV is fine as long as it includes request_id, timestamp, user, key_version, and raw_audit_id for replay. signed policies should be originals.

leo_oncall: I'll pull the logs. Splunk query I'll run (prod index):
```splunk
index=infra_audit env=prod service=inference event=kms.decrypt request_id=* | table _time request_id principal key_name key_version status raw_id
```

leo_oncall: sample (sanitized) results:
"2025-01-21T03:12:10Z request_id=ghi789 principal=svc-inference key_name=projects/redwood-kms/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/inference-key key_version=4 status=OK raw_id=AAFF12"
"2025-03-30T11:47:55Z request_id=ghi790 principal=svc-inference key_name=projects/redwood-kms/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/inference-key key_version=5 status=OK raw_id=BBCC34"
"2025-03-30T11:48:01Z request_id=ghi791 principal=svc-inference key_name=projects/redwood-kms/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/inference-key key_version=5 status=OK raw_id=BBCC35"

marta_infra: rotation metadata: inference-key history -- v1 (created 2022-11-10), v2 (rotated 2024-06-20), v3 (rotated 2025-03-30), v4 (test-only), v5 (promoted 2025-03-30). I can export kms.getKey and the signed manifest (sha256: 9f2a...78c4).

marta_infra: emergency unwraps: one event on 2024-11-02 during an incident (ephemeral unwrap token used). approval email thread available (ops-approvals@) and short-lived token logs retained. No other emergency unwraps in last 12 mo.

raj: RBAC changes — we export k8s rolebinding events to the audit index. I can provide a CSV with columns: timestamp, resource, actor, change_type, before_bindings, after_bindings, approval_id (if exception). Example row: 2025-02-05T08:14:02Z, RoleBinding/inference-runner, deploy-bot, PATCH, "subjects:[svc-inference]", "subjects:[svc-inference, infra-deploy-sa]", APPROVAL-2243

julia_auditor: please include the approval artifacts for exceptions (email/Confluence link) and the signed change request where available.

leo_oncall: validation check run during rotation: we monitored decrypt success rate and queue latency. snippet of monitoring query we used:
```bash
# hourly decrypt failures in last 24h
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood/api/query?query=sum(kms_decrypt_failures{env=prod}) by (hour)" | jq .
```
We observed zero failures for the 24h window around 2025-03-30.

marta_infra: key promotion logs (CloudKMS admin events) show user=marta_infra performed promote_key_version at 2025-03-30T11:45:00Z (audit_id=CKMS-777). I'll export that admin audit and the signed key policy (policy version v3 signed by security@redwood.com).

evidence-bot: Attached artifacts: s3://redwood-evidence/EVID-2026-102/kms-inference-key-manifest.json (sha256:9f2a...78c4), s3://redwood-evidence/EVID-2026-102/rbac-change-events-2024-2025.csv, s3://redwood-evidence/EVID-2026-102/decrypt-samples-prod-sanitized.csv

raj: vuln triage note: VULN-2025-410 (inference runtime TLS library) was remediated in prod 2025-01-10 (PR#4392). I'll include tracker links in the bundle.

julia_auditor: excellent. last two asks: 1) a tiny CSV mapping the three sample request_ids to deploy tags/CI build numbers, 2) the small runbook excerpt showing rotation steps and rollback trigger criteria.

leo_oncall: pushing request_id -> deploy mapping now (sanitized):
"ghi789, prod-svc-inference, build-20250120.3"
"ghi790, prod-svc-inference, build-20250330.7"
"ghi791, prod-svc-inference, build-20250330.7"

marta_infra: runbook excerpt attached to evidence bundle. ETA for full bundle: EOD PT today. ping me if auditors need replayable audit_ids.

julia_auditor: thank you all — i'll ingest the bundle and follow up if anything missing. :white_check_mark:
